title: Srikanth Advances in China Masters, Lakshya Sen Faces Early Exit
indian_angle: Indian fans will be keen to follow the progress of Kidambi Srikanth and concerned by Lakshya Sen's repeated early exits.
summary: Kidambi Srikanth secured his progression in the China Masters, while fellow Indian shuttler Lakshya Sen experienced another early exit, marking his third loss to the Canadian opponent this year.

title: BAI Announces Advanced Level-1 Coaches Course in Guwahati and Raipur
indian_angle: This course is crucial for developing coaching talent within India, directly impacting the future of Indian badminton.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has announced an advanced Level-1 Coaches Course to be held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14 to 23, 2026.

title: New Regulations Released for Inter State Team Championships 2026
indian_angle: These regulations govern one of India's premier domestic team events, which is vital for identifying national talent.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has released the official regulations for the upcoming Inter State Team Championships 2026, outlining rules and guidelines for participating teams.

title: Women's Doubles Pair Change for Junior World Championships Selection Trials
indian_angle: This update directly affects the composition of India's junior women's doubles team for a major international event.
summary: An important notification has been issued regarding a change in the women's doubles pair participating in the selection trials for the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: Indian Junior Team Coaching Camp Underway for Asia U17 & U15 Championships
indian_angle: This camp is preparing India's top young talent for significant continental junior championships, fostering future stars.
summary: A national coaching camp for the Indian team participating in the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is currently being held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati.

title: New 3x15 Scoring System Adopted for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: This significant rule change will impact how junior domestic tournaments are played and could influence player development in India.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and National Championships across the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.
